verdict.rationale: Remote-desktop software can be open source, so this story applies to AnyDesk, but nothing in the evidence shows the AnyDesk application's source is available under an open license. The only open-source item is a companion Python helper module for the REST API. That is a separate add-on, not the product's own source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
